subject: Repeated or concurrent btc_miner_runtime work allocation

original_condition.failure_mode: Repeated invocation against an unchanged template can rescan the same header coordinates.

properties: Canonical template descriptor retained with a compact lookup key.
BEGIN IMMEDIATE serializes allocator updates across callers sharing the same SQLite ledger.
Nonce intervals advance monotonically for an exact template.
At the end of the uint32 nonce domain, allocation rolls to the next uint64 extranonce.
Every allocation is appended to work_allocation history.
Changed template coordinates receive an independent allocation cursor.
Explicit KEX_EXTRANONCE/KEX_NONCE_START overrides are classified as EXPLICIT_OPERATOR_MANAGED rather than silently treated as safe automatic allocation.

bounded_reproduction.execution_scope: direct local allocator-mechanic exercise; not GitHub Actions and not multi-host

remaining_boundaries: Exact candidate-head repository test execution is blocked by the GitHub Actions account billing gate.
SQLite allocation is authoritative only for workers sharing the same allocator database/state volume.
Multi-host allocation with independent local state is not proven and must not be inferred from single-volume results.
Live Bitcoin Core execution remains a separate proof obligation.
promotion_effect: The original silent-repeat defect is corrected at the shared-volume candidate design level, but M08 remains unpromoted until head-bound tests and required live-node evidence are obtained.
retention_rule: Keep this failure and correction lineage even after acceptance so duplicate-work regressions can be tested explicitly.
